operative_clauses.judgment_reason: Ended by completion of its task under owner rule D-20261108-board-rule (research/readiness/owner_rulings/2026-11-08-haloander-decisions.md item 2) (a): the board was created to investigate the Pan American World Airways dispute and report to the President. The held report of Emergency Board No. 135 (SHA-256 b1d3ce3b1131...) bears the cover date line "JUNE 20, 1961"; the letter of transmittal, which names EO 10919 and submits the report, is dated June 20, 1961 on the page image (text layer: "WASHINGT0/% D.C., June ~0~ 1961."). So the task was performed on 1961-06-20. Disclosed under D-20261125-board-cover-date: the report date is read from the cover, whose date line reads cleanly; the letter of transmittal date line is damaged in the held text layer, and I read the held PDF page image (page 2), which shows "June 20, 1961." The report was made on or about that date; receipt by the President may have been later. The report time was extended once: EO 10926 (signed 1961-03-18, held text, FR page 26 FR 2331) extended until June 20, 1961 the time within which the board created by EO 10919 shall report; the held report (PDF page 8) recites the same order and says the parties had agreed to the extension. The report is dated the last day of the extended time. An extension moves a deadline and does not end the clause; EO 10926 is recorded as a later event. The deadline in the order (thirty days from its date) is not the end. EO:12553 (1986-02-25) stays the formal disposition, recorded as a later event.

WHEREAS this dispute has not here­

and ____

ment of the National Mediation Board,

terstate nnrtimfirp.fi to a degree such as to

portation service:
NOW, THEREFORE, by virtue of the 
authority vested in  me by section 10 O f 
the Railway Labor Act, as amended (45

the board shall be pecuniarily or other­

order.

research_rationale:
Correction of the filed claim for EO 10919 under owner rule D-20261108-board-rule (research/readiness/owner_rulings/2026-11-08-haloander-decisions.md item 2). Original: the held Federal Register text (26 FR 1463), read in full; heading, number, date and parties confirmed; the order has a board clause and a separate no-change sentence, so the inventory is split in two. Report: NMB report of Emergency Board No. 135, held bytes jobs/ptolemy-custody/output/raw/b1d3ce3b11318b96544082e0fa8ec72a99257f3e48140ce432f6af6284edb348.pdf, span from the cover to the sentence submitting the report; it names EO 10919 and dates the order of February 17, 1961, the carrier and the Flight Engineers' International Association. Report date 1961-06-20 (cover; letter page image agrees). Clause ends: board 1961-06-20; no-change period 1961-07-20 (inclusive; exclusive 1961-07-19). Whole-order end 1961-07-20. Formal disposition EO 12553 of 1986-02-25. Later events: EO 10926 (1961-03-18) extended the report time and is recorded; the later-events:ofr_catalog search lists EO 10926 and EO 12553 as the instruments naming this order, and the US Code and eCFR searches found no hits. I scanned the text layer of all 52 PDF pages for extension, stipulation, reconvening, supplemental report and retained jurisdiction and found no further extension, supplemental report or reconvening. Savings state and source are carried from the filed claim after I read EO 12553's held text.
